newsitem.title: UK: Eurobonds lack focus as market seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: Eurobonds lack focus as market seeks direction.

text.p: The primary market simmered down on Thursday as the market awaited direction from underlying bond markets, dealers said.
With little benchmark issuance to look forward to, they said, as most deals in the next week would be retail targeted and arbitrage-driven.
Meanwhile waiting for an opportunity in the swap markets to launch a long-awaited deal in the French franc sector is the U.S. national mortgage association Fannie Mae.
"Its impossible to reach Fannie Mae's funding targets at the current swap levels," a Societe Generale syndicate manager said.
"If market conditions allow us to reach Fannie Mae's target its likely that Merrill Lynch and Societe Generale will be mandated to launch an issue," he added.
The offering is expected to be for between 3.0 and 5.0 billion French francs at a 10 to 12 year maturity.

Market sources said at a 12 year maturity, a spread of around 14 basis points over French government paper was likely while at a 10 year maturity, a spread of 12 b.p. over was likely. But the Societe Generale syndicate manager said the maturity was flexible and could even be for five years if that was the best window of opportunity.
He said although the French institutional investors were cash rich, they were reluctant to invest at current levels and were waiting for the market to consolidate.
